reviews.review:
For anyone that  is looking for a good Vampire  game...

Just skip this game or get it somewhere for 10$, i got it for 15$ during sale and that was a good bargain imo.

First of all story is bad ,and is only present in game through image like slide show.

Gameplay is standard FPS, with not that good feeling to it. There are no  throwable objects in game, unless you pick certain characters. Its weird for me not to have some kind of grenade or other throwable in FPS game.
AI is broken and sometimes non existant....enemies will get stuck or they will fail to react to their friend being slaughtered in front of them. Vamps are nothing but common enemies with beefier hp and dmg. Unless you fight with special Vamps ( which are usually mini bosses)  They are OK at best.
Performance is something they could work on, while i got average fps around  60  most of the time, i did got stutters ,usually while sprinting.

All in all ,this game is only worth 10-15$ imo right now, i wanted my Vampire game fix , but this didnt help. Gonna wait for Bloodlines 2 , and hopefully that one is better.
This game was a failure. They needed to spend more time on it. Extremely boring story and underwhelming guns/powers. Someone said this is a $20 game not $70, I disagree don't even waste that.

Having finished the game, I have no idea why people hate it so much. It's mildly rough around the edges in places, but it's a perfectly solid game. Good story, interesting world to explore. It's maybe not worth it at all full price, but definitely worth picking up on sale.

i don't know why those bad reviews about this game.
i enjoyed it...an acceptable game play with sublime graphics and smooth experience.

i recommend this game for players who loves explore areas and complete quests.

Note I bought this for $19 during the sale. so many bugs in this game its nothing like arkane of old the game has alot of bugs like enemies floating forward humans and guns showing up as invisible  and still images as cutscenes this game is worth $9.99 no more than that the game is on patch number 3

I didn't know Redfall at its worst, I just started it (after patch 3) and I am enjoying it a lot, it is really fun and the secrets of the island are interesting. However, it is a gigantic step back from Arkane's previous works (the best ever games for me), which is a pity. But without painful comparisons, it would be unfair not to recommend it.

It still has some bugs, even after patch 3. I excuse almost all of them except two: the need to be connected to the Internet (with abrupt exits when it does not detect the server) and the real inability to play with people in co-op.
